description: This Java source file defines the BeanStreamPayment class, which implements the PaymentModule interface. It handles payment transactions such as authorization, capture, refund, and transaction processing with Beanstream's payment gateway. It constructs transaction requests, manages HTTP connections, parses responses, and includes configuration validation.

classes.name: BeanStreamPayment
classes.description: Implements the PaymentModule interface to process payments via Beanstream, including authorization, capture, refund, and transaction handling.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a transaction; currently returns null.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorize and capture transaction.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund or reversal transaction based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: sendTransaction
methods.description: Handles sending transaction requests to Beanstream via HTTP and parsing responses.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Constructs and sends transaction requests for payment processing.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response from Beanstream and constructs a Transaction object.

methods.name: formatUrlResponse
methods.description: Parses URL-encoded response payload into a map of response fields.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the necessary configuration keys are set for the payment module.
